tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /phar phyin khrid yig ngo mtshar can bzhugs/oṃ swā sti/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i don sgom tshul ni/dang por lam gyi rtsa ba dge ba'i bshes
༄༅/ /phar phyin khrid yig ngo mtshar can bzhugs/oṃ swā sti/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i don sgom tshul ni/dang por lam gyi rtsa ba dge ba'i bshes

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /phar phyin khrid yig ngo mtshar can bzhugs/

oṃ swā sti/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i don sgom tshul ni/ dang por lam gyi rtsa ba dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten pa ni/ sems mi 'gong pa nyid la sogs/ /zhes sogs kyi mtshan nyid ldan pa'i slob dpon la/ sangs rgyas rnams la lhag par byas/ /zhes sogs dang*/ sangs rgyas bsten dang kun 'dri dang*/ /zhes sogs kyi bsten tshul dang*/ chos kyi dgos pa chod par bya/ /bla ma'i drung du maṇḍal dang*/ /yan lag bdun pa dang*/ sangs rgyas dngos dang mtshungs par lta ba'i mos gus bsgom/ dmigs skor dang po'o/ / gnyis pa chos la mos pa bskyed pa ni/ sangs rgyas byang sems nyan rang 'phags pa thams cad kyi yon tan ji tsam pa de tsam shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la'ang yod de/ de rnams kyis 'di bsgoms pa las thob po zhes chos la mos pa bya/ dmigs skor gnyis pa'o/ / sangs rgyas bsten dang sbyin sogs dang*/ /zhes sogs mos pa bskyed pa'i rgyu la 'bad/ chos kyi 'phongs pa'i rgyu dag dang*/ /zhes sogs 'gal rkyen spangs/ gsum pa tshig la dmigs pa ni/ yan lag bdun pa dang*/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du 'gro bar byas nas/ lus rnam snang gi chos bdun bcas/ dran pa rnal du bzhag /bdag gis bsgom par bya ba'i chos de gang las byung ba'i sde snod ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /zhes bsam zhing*/ mnyam par 'jog /mdo sogs ming la sems 'jog go /zhes pa'i don yin no/ / thun mtshams la 'jug khar dge ba'i rtsa ba byang chub tu bsngo/ sngon 'gro dang rjes kyi bya ba 'og ma rnams la'ang 'dis rigs 'dre/ dmigs skor gsum pa'o/ / bzhi pa don la dmigs pa ni/ so so'i nang na tshul bzhin du/ /de yi don yang rnam par dpyod/ /zhes pa'i don yin te/ bdag gis thos bsam sgom gsum bya ba'i yul shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di la/ dang por gleng gzhi yod de/ de nas sems bskyed mdor bstan nas/ 'phrin las nyi shu rtsa bdun gyi bar/

yan lag rgyas bshad kyi rim pa ji lta ba bzhin du yod cing*/ mthar byams zhus/ rtag tu ngu*/ chos 'phags/ yongs gtad rnams yod la/ le'u 'di tsam shlau ka 'di tsam brjod bya yang 'di dag go zhes bya ba la sogs pa yang yang bsam zhing sgom mo/ /dmigs skor bzhi pa te sngon 'gro la de ltar bzhi'o/ / lnga pa lam dngos ni/ gnyis te/ dang po lam la 'jug pa'i sgo dang*/ gnyis pa lam dang 'bras bu'i rim pa'o/ /dang po la/ zhi gnas dang*/ lhag mthong gnyis/ dang po ni/ tshe 'di dang 'khor ba la yid 'byung ba'i skyo shas dang*/ las 'bras slu med yid ches kyi nges pa dang*/ stong nyid ma rtogs pa'i sems can la byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems rnams kyis thun gyi dbu zhabs bar gsum thams cad du/ bogs dbyung zhing*/ bskul ma 'debs/ dkon mchog gsum gyi yon tan dran pas/ dad pa rnam pa gsum gyis spro ba bskyed/ zhi gnas kyi ngo bo sems gnas pa'i thabs dgu dang*/ nyes pa lnga/ spong ba'i 'du byed brgyad la sogs pa brten/ snying po byings rgod spangs pa'i zhi gnas rnam dag la bkris na rnam bzhag rgyas bsdus ji ltar byas kyang 'dra'o/ /des na zhi gnas sgom tshul spyi dang mthun no/ /dmigs chen gcig go / gnyis pa lhag mthong la/ rjes dpag nges shes kyi lam dang*/ rtog med mngon sum gyi lam gnyis/ dang po la/ gang zag bdag med sgom tshul dang*/ chos kyi bdag med sgom tshul gnyis/ dang po ni/ nga'o zhes rnam par brtags pa'i yul la dmigs na/ nga zhes bya ba ma grub ste/ lus rnams ni rdul phran gyi bar du bshig nas dang*/ sems kyang skad cig gi bar du rnam par bshig na/ lus sems gnyis kyang nga ma yin la/ de gnyis kyi tshogs pa'ang ma grub pas ma yin/ de gnyis las logs pa'ang med pa'i phyir/ gang zag med par rtogs pa na/ de'i ngang la mnyam par bzhag go /dmigs chen gnyis/ bar bar du gang zag bdag 'gog gi rigs pa rnams shes na dran par bya zhing*/

des nges shes skye zhing bogs 'byin du 'gro/ gnyis pa ni/ gong bzhin du/ shes pa rnams la skad cig dang*/ don du snang ba rnams la rdul phran du sil/ skad cig ma dang*/ rdul phran yang sil bas/ mtha' med du 'gyur bas/ gzugs sgra sogs ngo bo'i mtshan ma dang*/ ka bum sogs bkod pa'i mtshan ma dang*/ khong khro dang dad pa la sogs shes pa'i mtshan ma gang yang med cing*/ cir yang ma grub pa la mnyam par bzhagadamigs chen gsum mo/ /de skabs gcig du bral/ yod med skye 'gog /mu bzhi skye 'gog /rdo rje gzegs ma/ rten 'brel sogs mtha' bral du gtan la 'bebs byed kyi rigs pa rnams shes na yang yang dran pas bogs che ba yin/ gnyis pa ni/ sngags kyi lam phyag rgya chen po'ang*/ 'khor lo tha ma'i mdo'i sgom rim ltar sems kyi rang bzhin la lta shes pa'i sgo nas mi rtog par bzhag pas/ rnam rtog rang dwangs la song*/ chu ma rnyog na dwangs pa'i tshul gyi rang bzhin gsal bar mngon du 'gyur ba yin/ dmigs chen bzhi pa ste/ de da la dbye na dmigs pa mang por 'gyur la/ de dag lam gyi 'jug pa'o/ / gnyis pa ni 'dir skabs brgyad la lam rim ngo bo tha dad pa med de/ 'chad tshul tha dad pa'i dbang gis phye bar shes dgos shing*/ des na/ rang don yid byed kyi kun nas bslangs nas/ dmigs yul bden pa bzhi la dmigs/ lta ba gang zag gi bdag med tsam dang*/ sgom pa mi rtag la sogs pa bcu drug gi zhi lhag /spyod pa nyes spyod sdom pa'i tshul khrims tsam la gnas pas ni/ nyan thos kyi 'bras bu thob pa yin te/ lam shes nyid kyi tshul la ni/ / 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi dag gi /zhes sogs kyi don no/ / de'i steng du/ lta ba gzung ba chos kyi bdag med bsnan/ spyod pa bskal ba brgya'i bar du tshogs gsog pa bsnan/ sgom pa rten 'brel bcu gnyis gtso bor sgom pa dang*/ mkhas par bya ba'i dngos po drug la mkhas par byed/ 'bras bu la mtshams sbyor byed rang rgyal du smon lam btab na/

rang sangs rgyas kyi 'bras bu thob par 'gyur/ de gnyis kyi rtogs par bya ba thams cad 'dir yang rtogs dgos pa yin mod/ thob bya rnams ni theg chen 'di'i gol sa yin pa'i phyir/ mngon du byed dgos pa ma yin no/ /des na rang rgyal gyi lam ni/ rang byung bdag nyid rtogs pa ni/ /zhes sogs kyi don no/ /theg chen gyi lam dang 'bras bu ste/ de la chos sku ni 'bras bu/ sbyor ba bzhi ni lam/ mkhyen gsum la ngo bo'i dbang du byas na/ rnam mkhyen 'bras bu dang*/ gzhan gnyis lam yin la/ de yang chos sku dang*/ sbyor ba bzhi las logs su med/ nang mkhyen gsum gyi rnam bzhag thos bsam gyi yul du byas nas/ yul de dang mthun pa'i nyams len sbyor ba bzhi la 'bad pas/ 'bras bu dngos su mngon du gyur pa ni/ chos sku 'phrin las dang bcas pa'o/ / de la mkhyen pa gsum gyi rnam bzhag ni/ mkhyen pa'i ngo bo tshig gis mtshon par dka' ba'i phyir/ mkhyen pa de rnams kyi gang mkhyen pa'i yul sogs la rgyas bshad byed pa ni/ mtshon byed kyi chos kyi go ba yin la/ de'i phyir skabs dang po gsum char las/ lam rim rgyas pa re re 'byung la/ cha shas kyi sgo nas/ lam rim cha tshang ba ni yang yang 'byung ngo*/ /de la theg chen gyi thun mong ma yin pa'i lam gyi thog ma ni/ sems bskyed nas 'go 'dzin cing*/ de nas skabs 'dir sems bskyed yang dag par len dgos/ sngar sems bskyed tsam blangs su zin kyang*/ sher phyin gyi lta bas zin pa dka' ba'i phyir/ bdag med gnyis la myong ba thon nas sems bskyed cho gas len pa'i tshe yang des zin pa dang*/ dge ba ci byed sems bskyed kyis zin par byed dgos pa'ang lta ba bzang po de dang nges par sbrel dgos/ de la bdag dang*/ sems can/ sdug bsngal gsum rang bzhin gyi ma dmigs kyang*/ de ltar ma rtogs pa'i sems can rnams bsgral bar bya'o snyam pa'i smon pa sems bskyed bsgom pa ste/

dmigs skor gcig /bdag dang lam rang bzhin gyi ma dmigs kyang 'gro ba la phan pa'i phyir du/ sbyin sogs la 'bad par bya'o snyam pa 'jug pa sems bskyed de/ dmigs bskor gnyis/ dkon mchog gsum dang*/ skyabs par bya ba'i yul 'khor ba pa thams cad rang bzhin gyi stong pa nyid yin kyang*/ kun rdzob tu 'khor ba pa rnams skyabs med mgon med yin/ de rnams kyi sdug bsngal dkon mchog gsum gyis bskyab nus par shes nas/ skyabs 'gro la 'bad pa ni/ rten dkon mchog gsum la 'doms pa'i gdam ngag ste/ dmigs skor gsum pa'o/ / 'phags pa mchog rnams kyi gzigs ngo dang*/ rigs pa'i ngo na/ blang bya dang*/ dor bya gang yang med kyang*/ kun rdzob rten 'brel 'gag pa med pa la/ las nyon yod phyin/ sdug bsngal 'byung*/ lam la 'bad na/ las nyon sdug bsngal 'gag par nges shes bskyed cing bsgom pa ni/ dmigs yul bden bzhi'i gdams ngag gi dmigs pa ste/ dmigs skor bzhi pa'o/ / dmigs pa de rnams la myong ba thon pa na/ thun bzhir skyabs 'gro sems bskyed kyi dmigs pa gsum po de rnams sngon du song ba'i rjes su/ thun gyi dngos gzhi bdag med gnyis kyi lta ba la/ zhi lhag zung 'brel du sgom bden bzhi la 'doms pa'i dmigs pa des bar bar du bogs 'don/ rjes sgom lam lam shes kyi skabs su bshad pa'i mos bsngo yid rang gsum gyi rgyur/ de dang mthun pa'i dmigs med kyi mos pa dang*/ bsngo ba dang*/ rjes su yid rang ba gsum tshar re bsgom/ thun mtshams su chos spyod kyi rim pa thams cad sngar gyi lta bas zin pa dang*/ lta ba des zin pa'i sbyin sogs la 'bad gang thub bya/ sgrub pa rang gi ngo bo la 'doms pa'i gdams ngag ste/ dmigs skor lnga pa'o/ / dmigs pa'i ngo bo ni/ phyis kyang 'di nyid kho na bsgom par bya ba yin mod kyi rnam pa 'dzin stangs kyi khyad par mi 'dra ba rnams bsnan pas dmigs pa tha dad par 'gyur ba yin no/

/de ltar bsgom pa'i gnas skabs su/ nyams rtogs cung zad skyes pa la/ nga rgyal dang*/ bzang zhen byung na/ ma zhen pa'i gdams ngag bsgom ste/ 'khor ba'i lus ngag yid gsum dang lam dang lam gyi 'bras bu gang yang ma dmigs na/ 'd-i tsam gyi nyams rtogs kyang gnas skabs bya rtsol gyi 'bras bu las byung ba'i sgyu ma lta bu yin pa'i phyir/ zhen du ci yod ces/ rang gi nyams myong bshig ste/ slar yang brtson 'grus drag tu rtsom pa ste/ dmigs skor drug pa'o/ / sangs rgyas thob pa ni shin tu dka' ste/ yun ring du thogs pa dang*/ dka' ba dpag tu med pa byed dgos pa'i phyir/ bdag gis mi nus pa 'dra'o snyam du sems pa byung na/ dus yun ring thung gnyis kar rang bzhin gyi ma dmigs/ bde sdug kun kyang 'khrul ba'i snang ba tsam las/ dngos gnas la grub pa med na/ yun thung ba dang*/ sla ba la dga' rgyu ci yod/ ring ba dang*/ dka' ba la mi dga' rgyu ci yod ces sgyid lug pa bsal nas/ brtson 'grus rtsom pa ni/ mi ngal ba'i brtson 'grus te/ dmigs skor bdun pa'o/ / lam yongs 'dzin dngos da lta med kyang*/ phyogs mthun ni/ chos thams cad stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can la 'bab pa'i thabs su byas pas/ theg chen gyi lam du ma 'dus pa'i chos gang yang med pa dang*/ rang gi nyams myong gis/ rang sems la phan thogs par byas nas/ skad cig snga ma'i nyams myong la dpags nas/ phyi ma'i gnas skabs su gang la'ang ma zhen pa dang*/ mnyam bzhag la mngon par dga' ba dang*/ lam dang 'bras bu la yid ches bskyed nas/ sgrub pa'i ngo bo 'bad rtsol bskyed pa ste/ dmigs skor brgyad pa'o/ / de dag tshogs lam gyi dmigs pa'o/ /skabs 'di dag tu/ mkhyen gsum gyi rnam pa rnams yang yang yid la byed pa dang*/ de rnams dang dmigs pa'i gzhi gcig tu byed pas gsal snang skyes pa na/ sbyor lam gyi rtogs pa skye bar 'gyur ro/ /man ngag gi tshe/

'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad yul dus gnas skabs/ rnam 'gyur gang yang ma dmigs par shes pa'i sgo nas/ rten bya'i lam mtha' dag la/ dngos dang*/ mos pa'i sgo nas bslabs pa nyid kyis rnam pa de thams cad bsgom par 'gyur zhing*/ re re bzhin du dmigs pa sbyor ba sgom dka' ba'i phyir/ bde blag tu rtogs pa'i man ngag tu mi 'gyur ro/ /'on kyang rnam pa de rnams kyi go ba ji bzhin du shes shing*/ yang yang yid la byas na/ nges shes skye shing*/ shin tu bogs che'o/ / de dag tshogs lam phyir mi ldog gi rtags thob thob kyi bar du 'bad par bya'o/ /de dag tu spyan lnga thob pa'i rgyu chos la mkhas par bya ba dang*/ mngon shes kyi thob pa'i rgyu ting nge 'dzin la 'bad par bya'o/ /sbyor lam gyi dmigs pa ni/ sngar gy-i gzhi'i dmigs pa'i steng du/ dmigs rnam 'di rnams yar ldan du bsnan pa yin te/ de la chos thams cad dbyings rang bzhin spros pa dang bral yang*/ kun rdzob rten 'brel sna tshogs su 'char ba 'gag pa med pa'i bden gnyis cha snyam la dmigs pa ni/ drod kyi dmigs pa'i gzhi ma yin la/ de las kyang gtso bor/ gzugs sogs kun rdzob kyi chos rnams bden pa yin pas/ de rnams spangs kyang gnas tshul la bri ba med cing*/ don dam ye shes gnas tshul la gsar thob med pa dang*/ ming thams cad don la 'brel ba med par shes par byas te mnyam par 'jog pa ni/ drod chung ngu ste/ gzugs sogs 'du 'god gnas bral dang*/ /zhes so/ /don rnams dang*/ ming rnams dang*/ de ltar 'dogs pa'i rgyu mtshan gang yang ma dmigs pa la mnyam par 'jog pa ni/ drod 'bring ste/ gnas dang rtags dang brjod du med/ /zhes so/ /gzugs nas rnam mkhyen gyi bar la/ kun rdzob kyi chos kun mi gnas pa ste/ rang rang ngo bos stong zhing*/ yongs grub/ kun btags gzhan dbang gnyis kyi ngor med par bsgom pa ste/ sems kyi rang bzhin brjod bral 'di dang*/

snang ba sna tshogs pa 'di dag thams cad rig pa skad cig ma'i ngo na 'brel ba can yang ma yin la/ tha dad du gnas pa yang ma yin par shes pa ni drod chen po'i dmigs pa ste/ gzugs sogs mi gnas zhes sogs so/ / gzugs sogs chos thams cad rang bzhin gyi grub pa med pas/ de'i skye 'gag sogs kyang 'khrul ba'o zhes dmigs pa ni/ rtse mo'i dmigs pa'i gzhi ma yin la/ 'dus byas rang bzhin gyi ma dmigs pa la/ rtag mi rtag gang yang bzung du med pa dang*/ de bzhin du bde sdug /bdag yod med/ zhi ma zhi/ stong mi stong sogs gang yang med par dbyings brjod bral ro gcig tu shes pas mnyam par 'jog pa ni/ rtse mo chung ngu'i dmigs pa ste/ de mi rtag sogs par mi gnas ces sogs so/ / gang du yang 'dzin pa med pa'i dbyings la/ rtse gcig tu mnyam par 'jog pa ni/ rtse mo 'bring ste/ chos rnams mi 'dzin sogs/ bsgom bya sher phyin gyi ngo bo gang yin/ bdag po gang gi phar phyin yin par 'gyur sher phyin zer ba'i rgyu mtshan ci/ bya ba dang las ji tsam 'grub na sher phyin du 'jog ces rnam par brtags pa na/ de bzhi char gyi ngo bo dbang yid kyi yul yang ma yin no/ /sgra dang rtog pas bsam zhing brjod du'ang med/ rtags dang mtshan ma gang gis kyang dmigs pa dang mtshon du med mod kyi/ ngo bo ni chos rnams rtogs pa ste/ gnas tshul la bzhugs pa tsam dang*/ chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin yin pa dang*/ ji lta ba bzhin du rtogs pa'i phyir dang*/ dag pa gnyis ldan du sangs rgyas pa na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yin no zhes nges par byas nas mnyam par 'jog pa ni rtse mo chen po ste/ shes rab kyis ni yongs rtog par/ /sogs so/ /

nang stong pa nyid la sogs pa/ stong nyid bcu drug gi sgo nas/ gzung 'dzin gyi chos gang yang med par bsgom pa ni/ bzod pa'i dmigs pa'i gzhi ma yin la/ gzugs nas rnam mkhyen gyi bar gyi chos la/ gzung 'dzin gyi chos gang gi yang ngo bo med la/ gzung 'dzin gnyis med pa'i ye shes ni/ thams cad kyi ngo bor gnas par shes nas/ kun rdzob kyi snang ba la sems mi spro bar rang bzhin dmigs pa med pa'i dbyings la mnyam par 'jog pa ni/ bzod pa chung ngu ste/ gzugs sogs ngo bo nyid med sogs so/ /nga dag pa'i dri bcas kyi gnas skabs na/ 'khrul ba'i chos skye ba dang 'byung ba med la/ dri med kyi gnas skabs na/ nges par 'byung ba ste myang 'das rang bzhin gyi ma grub pa dang*/ lus ngag yid gsum la mtshan ma gang du'ang mi 'dzin pa ni bzod pa 'bring ste/ de dag skye med sogs so/ / de nas 'dzin pa yid kyi rnam par shes pa yang rang bzhin gyi ma dmigs pa la gsal snang cung zad skyes pa na/ gzugs sogs kyi snang ba rnams su 'dzin pa log cing*/ snang ba la sems gnas kyang de dang de'i mtshan mar 'dzin pa mi 'char la mtshan ma med pa'i dbyings der lta bya lta byed bral bas bzo bcos med pa'i tshul du 'jog pa ni/ bzod pa chen po ste/ de dag mtshan ma med dag dang sogs so/ /chos thams cad skye 'gag gnas gsum dang bral ba'i ngo bo mnyam pa nyid du 'jog pa ni/ chos mchog gi dmigs pa'i gzhi ma yin la/ chos thams cad skye ba med pa la zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang*/ dpa' bar 'gro ba dang rin chen phyag rgya la sogs pa ting nge 'dzin brgya nyer gcig mdo las gsungs pa de dag ni/ sangs rgyas myur du thob par byed pa'i thabs ste/ de dag kyang rang bzhin gyi med mod kyi yon tan mngon par bsgrub pa'i phyir thob par bya'o zhes ting 'dzin de rnams la mdun pa drag tu bskyed cing*/ 'dun pa'ang stong nyid kyi lta bas zin par byed pa ni chos mchog chung ngu ste ting nge 'dzin de'i byed pa nyid ces sogs so/

/de'i tshe gnyis snang dang rnam rtog mngon 'gyur ba 'gag pas rjes thob tu yang mtshan mar zhen pa mi 'byung bas/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi mngon gsum du lung bstan pa na/ lung ston bya ston byed rang bzhin tha dad med par bsgoms pas/ 'du shes dang rlom sems 'gag pa ni/ chos mchog 'bring po ste/ lung ston pa dang sogs so/ / mnyam bzhag tu gnyis snang mngon 'gyur ba mtha' dag 'gags pas/ bsgom bya phar phyin dang*/ sgom ting nge 'dzin dang*/ sgom pa po byang chub sems pa gsum ming tha dad ma gtogs don dbye ba med pa la mnyam par bzhag pa de nyid dngos su mthong ba ni/ chos mchog chen po ste/ gsum po phan tshun sogs so/ / de dag gi skabs spangs bya rtogs pa'i rnam dbye dang*/ yon tan skabs lnga par bshad pa'i rtags/ rnam 'phel brtan pa sems kun gnas kyi rtse sbyor de bzhi dang skabs bzhi pa'i sbyor lam phyir mi ldog gi rtags rnams 'byung ba yin no/ /gzhan yang*/ yon tan rnam pa bcu bzhi sgrub par byed dgos shing*/ skyon bzhi bcu zhe drug spang bar byed pa dang*/ mtshan nyid rnams tshang ba'i phyir/ de dag la dmigs kyang dgos pa yin no/ /re re la'ang bogs 'don gyi phyir du/ mthar gyis pa'i sbyor ba rjes mthun pa sbyin pa la spyod cing*/ sbyin pa'i yon tan rgya cher sems pa dang*/ de la gzung 'dzin gyi mtshan ma 'gog pa sogs phar phyin drug dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi yon tan mtha' dag dran cing*/ lhag par dad pa bskyed pa/ de lta bu'i yon tan dang yon tan can gyi sangs rgyas la/ mtshan mar 'dzin pa dgag pa'i phyir/ de dag stong nyid du sgom pa sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa yin pas/ de sogs rjes dran drug dang kun rdzob kyi snang ba bkag nas/ bdag med kyi don bsgom pa dngos med ngo bo nyid kyi rnal 'byor ste/ bcu gsum po khrigs chags su yang yang bsgom par bya'o/ /mnyam rjes gang du yang*/

phyin drug la spyod pa'i tshe/ bsam pa la go sgrub dang*/ sbyor ba la 'jug sgrub tshang dgos shing de ltar tshogs bsags pa gnyis kyi tshogs sgrub kyang 'grub pa yin no/ /mthar gyis pas/ bogs 'don pa dang*/ go 'jug tshogs gsum gyi tshul de rgyun mtha'i snga logs kyi bar 'phags lam du yang de dang 'dra zhing*/ 'phags lam ni 'bras bu'i tshul du skye ba yin pas/ de dag skye ba'i rgyu tshogs ni/ gong du bshad pa de rnams las/ logs su mi dgos so/ /de dag gi rnam par bzhag pa rgyas par shes pas rtogs la/ chings ni 'di ltar shes dgos ste/ mthong lam la gdams pa dang*/ lam shes kyi mthong lam skabs dang*/ gzhi shes kyi mthong lam skabs dang*/ skabs bzhi pa'i mthong lam rnam rtog bzhi'i gnyen po can du byed tshul dang*/ bzhi pa'i phyir mi ldaug gi rtags sbyar te mthong lam gyi rnam bzhag zhib mor nges pa dang sgom lam la gdams pa dang skabs gnyis pa'i sgom lam gyi byed pa mos bsngo yid rang gsum sgrub pa sgom lam/ rnam dag sgom lam/ skabs bzhi pa'i sgom lam gyi rnam bzhag rnams dang*/ lnga pa'i sgom lam rnam rtog bzhi'i gnyen por 'gyur tshul rnam sgom lam gyi spyi'i rnam bzhag tu byas nas/ bye brag bcu so so la sa'i tshogs grub/ yongs sbyongs rnams dang*/ dag pa sa gsum gyis gnas skabs su nges 'byung sgrub pa dang*/ rgyun mtha'i skabs su skad cig ma'i sbyor ba dang*/ de dag tu nye bar mkho ba'i srid zhi mnyam nyid kyi sbyor ba zhing dag pa'i sbyor ba/ thabs mkhas kyi sbyor ba rnams so/ / bzhi lam 'bras bu'i gnas skabs thams cad du 'gyur ba med pa ni sgrub pa'i rten chos dbyings yin la/ ji ltar sgrub pa'i tshul gyi snying po ni/ dmigs pa'i chos bcu gcig po la rim pas dmigs pa yin no/ /de ltar sngon 'gro dmigs pa/ 'jug pa la dmigs chen rtsa ba bzhi/ tshogs lam la brgyad/ sbyor lam la bcu gnyis/

mthar phyin pa'i bcu gsum ste/ dmigs chen zhe brgyad/ dmigs phran mang por 'gyur ro/ /de ltar lam bsgoms pa'i 'bras bu ni/ ched du bya ba gsum dang sku gsum 'phrin las dang bcas pa 'chad pa yin pas/ de ltar na/ lam gyi tshul 'di ni/ theg pa chen po las/ shes rab zab mo stong pa nyid kyi nyams len gtso bo gyur pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i tshul yin la/ de'i gdams par grags pa shin tu mang na yang*/ rgyal tshab byams pa'i gzhung gi dgongs don 'di ni kun gyi rgyal po lta bu yin no/ /zhes pa'ang bka' bcu ba kun dga' legs grub gyis bskul nas/ tā ra nā thas smras pa'o// // dge legs 'phel/ / mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/phar phyin khrid yig ngo mtshan can bzhugs/ - PAGE 38 -- PAGE 37 -- PAGE 25 -
